Mateo / Lauren — read the redline. High-level legal positions and operational asks below.

Legal positions (draft comments):
- SCCs: we will append the current EU SCCs and include an execution statement in the signature block; no objection.
- DPA: StarlinY's redline currently requires a strict no-fallback clause in section 4.2. We cannot agree to a permanent, unconditional no-fallback; we can accept an EU-primary residency commitment plus a documented fallback with constraints (emergency-only, documented approval, SLA).
- Transfer-impact addendum: supportive — propose Redwood draft with trigger thresholds and an explicit 60-day operational notice by default, 30 days for emergency migrations.

Operational & pricing note (Lauren — pls confirm):
- If fallback to non-EU occurs, we need a pricing surcharge to cover egress/replication/ops. My commercial estimate is a 7% uplift on committed monthly fee for active cross-border traffic; open to more precise numbers from Product.
- We must be able to provide KMS locality attestation and a log export for the region period under NDA.

Action items:
1) Ben: will prepare a redline DPA with SCCs appended + draft transfer-impact addendum (ETA 10/23 EOD).
2) Lauren: confirm feasibility of supporting EU-primary with emergency fallback and provide a short note on expected lead time and cost delta (ETA 10/22 noon).
3) Mateo: book a 30-min triage with StarlinY legal if needed (I think a 30-min call w/ legal + product will clear open Qs).

--
Ben Carter

Hi all — technical feasibility note and estimated cost impact.

Summary: Redwood can support an EU-primary hosting commitment. Fallback to additional regions (US) is technically feasible but not a zero-effort operation — it requires replication of KV caches, key material changeover, and a brief routing change. We can provide a KMS locality attestation and audit log export as part of the addendum.

Estimated timeline & ops:
- Normal (planned) cross-region migration: ~60 days (testing + cutover).
- Emergency migration (security/legal compulsion): ~30 days with an emergency playbook.

Estimated cost delta:
- We recommend a fallback surcharge equal to 7% of committed monthly fees to cover extra replication and egress during fallback periods (aligns with Ben's note). If customer needs dedicated on-prem or private VPC for permanent EU-only constraint, we should move to a Dedicated/Private pricing conversation (separate SOW).

Next steps proposed:
1) Ben finalizes the DPA redline with transfer-impact addendum language (we need clear triggers, timelines, KMS/log attestation clause).
2) Mateo to propose a 30-min legal+product call with StarlinY this week; I can join and cover the technical constraints.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Product Lead, Platform
Redwood Inference
